... they draw a card from one of the hideout decks. This card will get removed from the Marshal's hand since the Fugitive can never play this hideout.

The Fugitive takes 2 turns in a row WITHOUT drawing any cards.

The Marshal gets to draw 2 cards instead of 1.

preset.text:
The Fugitive has reached the 42, but because the Marshal has not flipped over a card higher than 30, it's time for a manhunt.

This is the Marshal's last chance to catch the Fugitive. The Marshal must guess one hideout at a time until they flip all the Fugitive's hideouts. If they ever make an error, the manhunt is over and the Fugitive wins! But if the Marshal flips all the remaining hideouts successfully, the Marshal wins!
